in_hebrew.name: Usa
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Usa הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Aphrodite-Usas, meaning 'Strong and Compassionate'. In Greek mythology, Usas was a goddess of strength and the protector of the islands. In Christianity, the name Usa represents the strong, compassionate nature of God.
